description: The gate tier (GX-11, D-070): derived from the invocation (D-B5: --tier3 3, --pr 1, --sha without --pr 2) and which tiers may use box-local caches (D-065 (5), GA-P02 strict).

gate-tier.batch.description: Tier of a gate-local invocation (D-B5; gate_tier.derive, first match in the order battery, per_pr, batch, working_tree), exported by gate-hooks/tier.sh as OU_GATE_TIER. --sha without --pr: the train's batch (train.tier2_command through scripts/gate-batch) or a hand --sha run, uncached. Values are the verdict contract's tiers: 1 per-PR, 2 batch, 3 battery.

gate-tier.battery.description: Tier of a gate-local invocation (D-B5; gate_tier.derive, first match in the order battery, per_pr, batch, working_tree), exported by gate-hooks/tier.sh as OU_GATE_TIER. --tier3: the battery on an integration tip (battery.tier3_command). Values are the verdict contract's tiers: 1 per-PR, 2 batch, 3 battery.

gate-tier.cacheable_tiers.description: Gate tiers that may read and write box-local markers (the stage/step result cache and the per-test script cache). Tier 2 (the train's batch) and tier 3 (the battery) never do: D-065 (5) under GA-P02 strict (P-43). Rollback [1, 2] only with a D-NNN, since it breaks D-065 (5).

gate-tier.content_cacheable_tiers.description: D-076 (P-56, partially refutes P-43): gate tiers that reuse a script-test or stage PASS by content (its key: the files it reads, the attested toolchain_id, the judging runner), with gate.content_cache_enabled on. Tier 3 (the battery, the periodic full net) is never listed. gate-tier.cacheable_tiers keeps the box-local carry-over and recorded verdicts to tier 1.

gate-tier.per_pr.description: Tier of a gate-local invocation (D-B5; gate_tier.derive, first match in the order battery, per_pr, batch, working_tree), exported by gate-hooks/tier.sh as OU_GATE_TIER. --pr: the per-PR gate (gate-dev/gate-db --pr; also gate_noite's --noite --sha --pr). Values are the verdict contract's tiers: 1 per-PR, 2 batch, 3 battery.

gate-tier.working_tree.description: Tier of a gate-local invocation (D-B5; gate_tier.derive, first match in the order battery, per_pr, batch, working_tree), exported by gate-hooks/tier.sh as OU_GATE_TIER. Neither --pr nor --sha: the working tree (gate-quiet), not a recorded proof. Values are the verdict contract's tiers: 1 per-PR, 2 batch, 3 battery.
